criteria.name: dramatic_specificity
criteria.description: The beat summary names what one character wants and what concretely stands in the way — not 'they discuss X' but 'A demands B do Y; B refuses because Z.' Test: if the summary describes a conversation topic rather than a specific action and obstacle, score 0–35. If the beat could not happen with any other characters or at any other moment, score 70+.

criteria.name: causal_coherence
criteria.description: The beat makes sense as a step toward its reachable endings. The dramatic_purpose reveals something the player didn't know before — a fact, a betrayal, a changed power dynamic. Test: if the beat could be removed from the chain without affecting any ending, score 0–35. If the player's understanding of the situation is demonstrably different after this beat, score 70+.

criteria.name: choice_stakes
criteria.description: For branch nodes, choice_labels describe real decisions with consequences — not scene summaries or dialogue excerpts. Each label implies a different future, not just a different next scene. Test: if labels are 'Option A' / 'Option B' or summarize what happens next, score 0–30. If labels present a genuine moral or strategic dilemma the player must weigh, score 70+. (Non-branch nodes: score this criterion 75 by default — not applicable.)

criteria.name: forward_momentum
criteria.description: The beat sets up its children naturally — the transition to each child follows from what happened here. emotional_tone matches the summary content. Characters present are the ones who would logically be in this scene given the story's flow.
